title: Calendar range
description: Select a short stay with a continuous, legible date range.
useCase: Select a short stay with a continuous, legible date range.
reducedMotion: Live system preference disables decorative motion; all controls remain usable. Keyboard actions settle immediately.
limitations: A fixed November 2026 calendar; dates, locale, availability, and persistence belong to the host application.
look: Pale grey-green page with a white rounded calendar card: bold month heading, seven-column day grid, deep green endpoint chips and a mint band between.
motion: Clicking a start then an end date fills the range: endpoints turn deep green and in-between days mint, each cell's background and text colour transitioning over 140 ms.
adapt: Selection logic is `choose` (a click after a complete range, or before `from`, restarts it); cells get `first`, `middle` and `last` classes whose 140 ms background transition is the only motion. Replace the fixed 30-day November grid with real dates and availability.
